description.zh: 橙黑撞色与错落卡片，把个人主页变成一张二次元海报。
description.en: Orange, black, and an irregular card collage turn a personal homepage into an anime-inspired poster.

zh: 用一个高饱和主色统领标题、按钮和分隔元素。
把项目、相册和个人介绍做成大小不同的入口卡片。
粗边框与硬阴影能强化卡片的可点击感。
en: Carry one saturated color across headings, buttons, and dividers.
Give projects, photos, and the author different-sized entry cards.
Use heavy outlines and hard shadows to make cards feel tangible.

bestFor.zh: 个性首页、兴趣入口、项目导航
bestFor.en: Expressive homepages, interest hubs, project navigation

description.zh: 一张三维工作桌，搭配紧凑的个人介绍与作品入口。
description.en: A miniature 3D desk gives a compact biography and portfolio a memorable focal point.

zh: 把三维场景限制在首屏的一小块，给内容留出空间。
窄栏介绍用清晰小标题划分经历与兴趣。
让头像与三维场景共同表达作者身份。
en: Keep the 3D scene contained so the writing still has room.
Break a narrow biography into clear sections for work and interests.
Let the portrait and miniature scene express the same identity.

bestFor.zh: 轻量三维首页、个人介绍
bestFor.en: Compact 3D homepages and biographies

description.zh: 用经典桌面窗口、任务栏与图标组织当代前端作品。
description.en: Classic desktop windows, a taskbar, and icons frame a contemporary frontend portfolio.

zh: 把作品、客户和近期文章分配到不同窗口。
统一窗口边框与标题栏，让复古语言保持完整。
桌面图标让导航成为整体场景的一部分。
en: Assign work, clients, and recent posts to separate windows.
Keep borders and title bars consistent across the desktop.
Make navigation icons part of the scene rather than a separate menu.

bestFor.zh: 复古桌面、作品与文章混合首页
bestFor.en: Retro desktops and combined work-and-writing homepages

description.zh: 点阵背景、黑色硬阴影与鲜明色块，为开发者主页增加性格。
description.en: A dotted canvas, hard black shadows, and bright blocks give this developer homepage character.

zh: 用点阵建立背景质感，同时保留纯色文字区域。
按钮与信息块共用黑边和偏移阴影。
大标题与等宽小字形成尺度反差。
en: Use dots for texture while keeping text surfaces calm.
Share the same outline and offset shadow across buttons and panels.
Contrast a large heading with compact monospace labels.

bestFor.zh: 开发者主页、文章卡片
bestFor.en: Developer homepages and article cards

description.zh: 图形实验进入博客首屏，视觉演示与技术写作相互支撑。
description.en: Graphics experiments lead into a blog where visual demonstrations support technical writing.

zh: 将自己的实验作品直接作为首屏视觉。
用深色背景突出发光粒子与图形细节。
把长文章中的概念做成可操作的可视化。
en: Use an original experiment as the hero visual.
Let a dark canvas emphasize particles and lighting.
Turn difficult concepts inside long articles into interactive visualizations.

bestFor.zh: 图形学博客、互动技术文章
bestFor.en: Graphics blogs and interactive technical essays

description.zh: 纸张质感与目录式导航，让个人网站像一本有自己封面的书。
description.en: Paper texture and a contents-page navigation make the site feel like a book with its own cover.

zh: 把导航设计成目录，形成明确的阅读隐喻。
用有性格的标题字体承担主要视觉表达。
保存历年版本，展示个人设计风格的演变。
en: Turn navigation into a table of contents with a clear reading metaphor.
Let a distinctive display face carry the visual identity.
Keep an archive of redesigns to show how a personal style evolves.

bestFor.zh: 书籍感博客、改版档案
bestFor.en: Book-like blogs and redesign archives

description.zh: 小车、灯光与立体场景，让访问作品集成为一次游玩。
description.en: A small vehicle, lighting, and a three-dimensional world make the portfolio a place to play.

zh: 用可探索场景替代传统的作品目录。
进入前的场景预览先交代世界的气氛。
让驾驶与发现作品成为同一个过程。
en: Replace a conventional project index with an explorable world.
Set the atmosphere with a scene preview before entry.
Connect movement through the world with discovering projects.

bestFor.zh: 独立互动首页、创意实验
bestFor.en: Interactive landing pages and creative experiments

description.zh: 复古电脑与办公室微缩场景，承载可进入的个人桌面。
description.en: A retro computer in a miniature office opens into a personal desktop.

zh: 用真实物件的空间关系建立一个可理解的三维入口。
开机过程与桌面窗口使用一致的年代语言。
将项目入口装进电脑屏幕，建立探索的层次。
en: Use familiar objects to make a 3D entrance easy to understand.
Keep the boot sequence and desktop windows in the same visual era.
Put project navigation inside the monitor to add a layer of discovery.

bestFor.zh: 三维个人空间、复古作品集
bestFor.en: 3D personal spaces and retro portfolios

description.zh: 深蓝底色与左右分栏，让经历、作品和个人介绍各有位置。
description.en: A deep navy canvas and split layout give biography, experience, and projects a clear place.

zh: 左侧保持身份与导航，右侧承载较长内容。
用克制的颜色层次区分正文与辅助信息。
项目卡片将标题、说明和技术标签组合成一个整体。
en: Keep identity and navigation on the left while longer content lives on the right.
Separate body text and metadata with restrained color levels.
Group project titles, descriptions, and technology tags into one unit.

bestFor.zh: 开发者履历、深色作品集
bestFor.en: Developer résumés and dark portfolios

description.zh: 灰阶生成图形占据画面，纤细文字沿边界组织作品与身份。
description.en: Grayscale generative graphics fill the canvas while fine typography organizes identity and work around its edges.

zh: 用单色图形获得视觉张力，而不依赖多种颜色。
让文字与图形共享清楚的边界和对齐关系。
以小字号导航反衬大尺度背景。
en: Find visual tension in monochrome graphics instead of many colors.
Align text and graphics to a clearly defined frame.
Use small navigation to contrast with the scale of the background.

bestFor.zh: 实验性首页、生成艺术背景
bestFor.en: Experimental homepages and generative backgrounds

description.zh: 柔和云层与友好的文章编排，让技术博客拥有轻松的阅读气氛。
description.en: Soft clouds and approachable article layouts give technical writing a welcoming atmosphere.

zh: 首屏插画建立气氛，下方仍然以文章为中心。
目录与热门内容为长篇教程提供第二条入口。
把动画和交互演示放到真正需要解释的内容里。
en: Use the hero illustration to set a mood without displacing the articles.
Offer categories and popular posts as alternative reading paths.
Place interaction where it helps explain a concept.

bestFor.zh: 教程博客、文章交互组件
bestFor.en: Tutorial blogs and interactive article components

description.zh: 大号衬线文字与数字花园结构，连接文章、笔记和视觉思考。
description.en: Large serif typography and a digital-garden structure connect essays, notes, and visual thinking.

zh: 用一句具体的自我定位代替冗长介绍。
把完整文章与仍在生长的笔记分开组织。
让插画帮助解释思想，而不只是装饰封面。
en: Lead with a precise statement of what the author makes.
Separate finished essays from notes that are still developing.
Use illustrations to explain ideas rather than merely decorate covers.

bestFor.zh: 数字花园、视觉长文
bestFor.en: Digital gardens and visual essays

description.zh: 高对比文字与亮黄色图形构成充满实验感的交互设计名片。
description.en: High-contrast text and a bright yellow form create an experimental interaction-design calling card.

zh: 把身份描述本身做成主视觉，而不是另加大图。
高饱和图形只用在最需要注意的位置。
作品与设计笔记共存，让过程也成为展示内容。
en: Make the identity statement itself the hero graphic.
Reserve saturated shapes for a deliberate focal point.
Show design notes alongside finished work to expose the process.

bestFor.zh: 设计师名片、交互作品展示
bestFor.en: Designer calling cards and interaction showcases

description.zh: 极简文字页把注意力交给组件作品与交互设计文章。
description.en: A restrained text page puts component work and interaction-design writing first.

zh: 用短小分组表达现在的工作、项目与写作。
窄阅读宽度让技术介绍容易连续阅读。
用文章解释组件取舍，给作品补足上下文。
en: Group current work, projects, and writing into short sections.
Keep a narrow reading measure for continuous text.
Explain component decisions in articles alongside the demos.

bestFor.zh: 极简主页、组件作者博客
bestFor.en: Minimal homepages and component-author blogs

description.zh: 开源项目、写作与摄影在简洁的个人页面中自然并列。
description.en: Open-source projects, writing, and photography sit naturally together on a simple personal page.

zh: 把代表项目直接嵌入介绍，让履历可以继续探索。
为摄影、演讲和博客提供同等清楚的入口。
小图标导航节省空间，但保留明确的可访问名称。
en: Link representative projects directly from the introduction.
Give photography, talks, and writing equally clear entry points.
Keep compact icon navigation meaningfully labeled.

bestFor.zh: 多兴趣主页、开源作者介绍
bestFor.en: Multi-interest homepages and open-source profiles

description.zh: 柔和色彩与居中的个人介绍，为写作和项目留出轻盈入口。
description.en: Soft colors and a centered introduction create a light entry into writing and projects.

zh: 在介绍中用少量强调色突出关键词。
头像、简述和社交入口组成完整的身份区。
将近期写作放在个人介绍之后，连接人和内容。
en: Highlight a few key words instead of coloring the entire heading.
Combine portrait, short biography, and social links into one identity area.
Follow the introduction with recent writing to connect the person to their work.

bestFor.zh: 中文个人博客、个人品牌首页
bestFor.en: Chinese personal blogs and identity-led homepages

description.zh: 侧栏导航、精选横排和文章摘要，为中文内容建立清楚层级。
description.en: Sidebar navigation, a horizontal featured row, and article excerpts create clear layers for Chinese writing.

zh: 将常驻导航与文章流分开，降低内容密度感。
精选内容用封面横排，普通文章保持纵向浏览。
日期、字数和分类放在次级位置，不抢标题。
en: Separate persistent navigation from the article stream.
Use covers for featured posts and a vertical list for everyday writing.
Keep date, length, and category subordinate to the title.

bestFor.zh: 中文文章列表、内容较多的博客
bestFor.en: Chinese article indexes and content-rich blogs

description.zh: 网格、荧光色和描边大字，把技术履历变成一张开发者海报。
description.en: Grids, fluorescent accents, and outlined lettering turn a technical résumé into a developer poster.

zh: 描边标题与实心文字形成层次。
用一个亮色集中标记主要按钮与状态。
技能和项目沿用文件名、终端等统一语汇。
en: Contrast outlined headings with solid text.
Concentrate one bright accent on primary actions and status.
Reuse a consistent vocabulary of files and terminals across skills and projects.

bestFor.zh: 海报式作品集、技术项目介绍
bestFor.en: Poster-like portfolios and technical project pages

description.zh: 大号衬线标题搭配可选主题，让个人博客兼具阅读感与可玩性。
description.en: Large serif headings and selectable themes give a personal blog both readability and playfulness.

zh: 用一句短标题说明作者做什么。
通过主题选择让同一套内容呈现不同气质。
精选文章同时展示标题与说明，方便快速判断。
en: Say what the author does in a short, direct heading.
Let theme choices change the mood of the same content.
Pair featured titles with explanations to help readers choose.

bestFor.zh: 主题切换、技术博客首页
bestFor.en: Theme switching and technical blog homepages

description.zh: 侧栏、个人时间线与像素小图，让知识库保留个人气息。
description.en: A sidebar, personal timeline, and pixel illustration keep a knowledge collection personal.

zh: 时间线把作者经历压缩为容易扫读的段落。
专题书架给旧文章提供新的阅读路径。
小型像素插画为文字密集页面增加识别度。
en: Condense a biography into a scannable timeline.
Use curated shelves to create new paths through older posts.
Add a small pixel illustration to give a dense text page identity.

bestFor.zh: 知识型博客、专题归档
bestFor.en: Knowledge blogs and curated topic archives

description.zh: 巨大的描边名字与朴素文章列表，形成直接而鲜明的博客首页。
description.en: An oversized outlined name contrasts with a plain article list for a direct, distinctive homepage.

zh: 用作者名字作为视觉锚点。
让正文回归朴素列表，平衡标题的表现力。
文章标题下用简短说明交代阅读收益。
en: Use the author’s name as the visual anchor.
Balance expressive lettering with a plain article list.
Add a brief line under each title to explain why it is worth reading.

bestFor.zh: 文字型博客、标题字体表达
bestFor.en: Text-first blogs and expressive mastheads

description.zh: 浅色云雾背景、头像与紧凑链接，构成轻盈的个人兴趣入口。
description.en: A pale cloud-like background, avatar, and compact links form a light personal-interest hub.

zh: 用低对比背景承载个人气氛，不压过主体。
将常用兴趣与社交链接组织成紧凑图标群。
首屏只保留自我介绍，把深入内容交给下方入口。
en: Use a low-contrast background to set the mood without overwhelming the content.
Group interests and social destinations into compact icon sets.
Keep the opening focused on identity and let links lead deeper.

bestFor.zh: 兴趣主页、轻量个人入口
bestFor.en: Interest-driven homepages and compact personal hubs

description.zh: 稳定侧栏配合纵向文章流，适合将博客与项目文档长期放在一起。
description.en: A persistent sidebar and vertical article stream support both blogging and project documentation.

zh: 把文章分类、项目和搜索放入稳定的导航区。
标题与摘要之间保留足够间距。
专栏与归档给持续增加的内容提供组织方式。
en: Keep categories, projects, and search in a stable navigation area.
Give titles and excerpts enough separation.
Use series and archives to organize a growing body of work.

bestFor.zh: 长文博客、项目文档、专栏
bestFor.en: Long-form blogs, documentation, and article series

description.zh: 可互动的小熊工作角与深色内容区，让个人站多了一点生活感。
description.en: An interactive bear workspace and dark content panels give a personal site a lived-in feel.

zh: 用一个可互动角色代替静态装饰。
角色的日常动作与作者的工作主题呼应。
让文章入口留在场景之后，兼顾趣味与内容。
en: Use an interactive character in place of a static ornament.
Connect the character’s small actions to the author’s working life.
Follow the scene with writing so play and content both have a place.

bestFor.zh: 角色互动首页、个人生活与技术博客
bestFor.en: Character-led homepages and personal tech blogs

description.zh: 每个小实验都有独立视觉，统一缩略图网格让人想一路点下去。
description.en: Each experiment has its own visual identity, held together by a consistent thumbnail grid.

zh: 让项目封面直接展示玩法而不只是标题。
统一卡片尺寸，为多种画风提供共同秩序。
简短页面说明把浏览重点留给实验本身。
en: Let project covers hint at the interaction rather than just show a title.
Use consistent thumbnail dimensions to organize varied visual styles.
Keep the introduction short so the experiments lead.

bestFor.zh: 个人实验室、小游戏索引
bestFor.en: Personal playgrounds and small-game indexes

description.zh: 手绘感与可玩解释并存，作品列表充满作者自己的语气。
description.en: A hand-drawn sensibility and playable explanations give the work index a distinct authorial voice.

zh: 让缩略图延续作品里的绘画语言。
用直白的小标题区分可玩内容与其他作品。
将订阅入口放在介绍旁边，方便关注后续创作。
en: Carry the illustration language of each project into its thumbnail.
Use direct section labels to distinguish playable work.
Place subscription options beside the introduction for returning readers.

bestFor.zh: 互动故事、手绘风作品页
bestFor.en: Interactive stories and illustrated work indexes

description.zh: 克制的介绍与小型交互线索，把精力留给实验作品。
description.en: A restrained introduction and small interactive cues direct attention toward experimental work.

zh: 把一个短句作为个人定位的核心。
小型动态元素比大面积动画更容易融入文字页。
从介绍直接链接到实验，缩短发现作品的路径。
en: Build the identity around one short statement.
Let small interactive elements sit naturally within a text page.
Link directly from the introduction to experiments.

bestFor.zh: 设计工程师主页、微交互参考
bestFor.en: Design-engineer homepages and micro-interactions

description.zh: 极轻的侧导航与窄文字栏，让作品、思考和图片各自安静展开。
description.en: A light side navigation and narrow text column give work, thoughts, and images space to breathe.

zh: 少量链接足以支撑个人网站的主结构。
通过间距区分段落，减少容器与边框。
正文链接让经历和项目自然连接。
en: Use a few links to support the main site structure.
Separate paragraphs with spacing instead of extra containers.
Connect experience and projects through inline links.

bestFor.zh: 极简个人主页、文字介绍
bestFor.en: Minimal personal sites and written introductions

description.zh: 头像、渐变名字与两个主要入口，快速说明独立开发者身份。
description.en: A portrait, gradient name, and two primary links communicate an independent developer’s identity quickly.

zh: 首屏只突出最重要的产品与代码入口。
头像与姓名建立比技能清单更直接的身份感。
将完整产品目录留在独立页面。
en: Prioritize the two most important destinations: apps and code.
Use a portrait and name for a direct sense of identity.
Keep the full product catalog on its own page.

bestFor.zh: 独立开发者名片、产品入口
bestFor.en: Independent developer profiles and product hubs

description.zh: 半边设计、半边代码的人像，把双重职业身份变成一眼能懂的画面。
description.en: A portrait split between design and code makes a dual professional identity instantly understandable.

zh: 让人物视觉表达你的两个核心能力。
左右标题与人像分区保持呼应。
用少量导航让首屏概念保持完整。
en: Make a portrait communicate two core skills.
Align headings with the two halves of the visual.
Keep navigation small so the hero concept stays intact.

bestFor.zh: 双重身份介绍、个人品牌首屏
bestFor.en: Dual-discipline introductions and personal-brand heroes

description.zh: 深蓝底色与视频作品展示，为剪辑和混合媒介作品建立统一背景。
description.en: A deep blue canvas unifies video editing and mixed-media work.

zh: 统一背景色可以容纳差异很大的视频封面。
开头直接说明创作领域，减少访客猜测。
按媒介分类作品，让浏览者快速找到相关项目。
en: Use one background color to hold varied video thumbnails together.
State the creative discipline immediately.
Organize work by medium so visitors can find relevant projects.

bestFor.zh: 视频作品集、混合媒介展示
bestFor.en: Video portfolios and mixed-media collections

description.zh: 柔和渐变、绿色大字与圆润项目块，形成亲切的设计师作品集。
description.en: Soft gradients, green display type, and rounded project panels form an approachable design portfolio.

zh: 在柔和背景上使用清晰的深色主标题。
让项目封面之间保留足够空隙。
导航保持紧凑，把页面主体留给作品。
en: Put a clearly contrasting heading over a soft background.
Leave generous room between project covers.
Keep navigation compact and give the work the main stage.

bestFor.zh: 柔和色彩作品集、项目封面
bestFor.en: Soft-color portfolios and project covers

description.zh: 人物照片、超大姓名与流畅转场，形成直接的创意开发者名片。
description.en: A portrait, oversized name, and fluid transitions create a direct creative-developer identity.

zh: 让人物照片与文字共享首屏，而不是分成两个卡片。
大字承担品牌识别，小字解释具体服务。
项目列表的交互可以提供预览，不必始终铺满图片。
en: Let portrait and typography share one hero rather than separate cards.
Use large type for identity and small type for concrete services.
Use project-list interactions to reveal previews on demand.

bestFor.zh: 动态作品集、人物主视觉
bestFor.en: Motion-led portfolios and portrait heroes

description.zh: 温暖纸色、作者介绍与书架式模块，装下写作、节目与长期项目。
description.en: Warm paper tones, a personal introduction, and shelf-like modules hold writing, shows, and ongoing projects.

zh: 将文章、书籍和项目分区，避免单一时间流埋没重点。
头像与作者介绍建立内容之间的共同身份。
让经典文章成为长期入口，而非只展示最新内容。
en: Separate essays, books, and projects rather than relying on chronology alone.
Use the author profile to tie diverse content together.
Keep foundational writing accessible alongside recent work.

bestFor.zh: 多栏目作者网站、长期内容索引
bestFor.en: Multi-format author sites and evergreen indexes

description.zh: 居中刊头、简洁分类与柔和背景，让中文博客带一点刊物感。
description.en: A centered masthead, simple categories, and soft background give a Chinese blog a publication-like feel.

zh: 让刊头与文章列表共享同一条中轴。
用轻量分类标签代替复杂导航层级。
日期与文章标题分开排版，保留阅读节奏。
en: Align the masthead and article list to one central axis.
Use lightweight categories instead of deep navigation.
Separate dates from headlines to preserve a reading rhythm.

bestFor.zh: 中文随笔博客、刊物式列表
bestFor.en: Chinese essay blogs and publication-style indexes

description.zh: 文字介绍与彩色城市插画并列，笔记和博客入口直接可见。
description.en: A written introduction sits beside a colorful city illustration, with notes and blog links immediately available.

zh: 用单张强识别插画平衡文字密度。
笔记按主题分组，长文按时间列出。
长短介绍切换让不同读者自行选择信息量。
en: Balance dense text with one recognizable illustration.
Group notes by topic and essays by date.
Let readers choose between a short and long biography.

bestFor.zh: 技术作者首页、笔记与博客组合
bestFor.en: Technical author homepages and notes-plus-blog layouts

description.zh: 几段文字与并列的小型列表，展示对界面细节的关注。
description.en: A few paragraphs and compact parallel lists show an interest in interface craft.

zh: 把正在做的事、项目和写作并列呈现。
靠字体权重与间距组织层次，不依赖卡片。
将短描述放在链接旁边，减少跳转前的不确定性。
en: Present current work, projects, and writing side by side.
Build hierarchy through weight and spacing rather than boxes.
Put brief descriptions beside links to explain the destination.

bestFor.zh: 极简开发者主页、轻量索引
bestFor.en: Minimal developer homepages and lightweight indexes

description.zh: 温暖底色与低干扰文字列表，将个人网站变成持续写作的地方。
description.en: A warm canvas and quiet text index make the personal site a place for ongoing writing.

zh: 首页同时介绍作者与最近文章。
年份分组帮助浏览较长的写作历史。
短摘要提供阅读线索，而不占满首屏。
en: Introduce both the author and the latest essay on the homepage.
Use year groups to navigate a longer writing history.
Offer short excerpts without filling the entire opening screen.

bestFor.zh: 随笔博客、长期写作归档
bestFor.en: Essay blogs and long-term writing archives

description.zh: 暗色画布上的精简目录，把设计、书籍、拼贴与文章串在一起。
description.en: A concise index on a dark canvas connects design, books, collage, and writing.

zh: 把个人站当作作品之间的入口，而不必展示所有细节。
双栏目录区分作者信息与项目链接。
用极少的色彩保持文字导航的统一气质。
en: Treat the personal site as a hub rather than a place to show every detail.
Separate author information and project destinations in two columns.
Use a small palette to unify a text-led index.

bestFor.zh: 设计作者入口、跨媒介作品导航
bestFor.en: Designer hubs and cross-medium navigation

description.zh: 字体作品和书籍封面成为主角，轻巧导航让视觉内容自然展开。
description.en: Lettering and book covers take the lead beneath a light, compact navigation.

zh: 让作品本身的字体承担视觉多样性。
封面按统一节奏排列，保持浏览秩序。
简短作者介绍帮助访客理解跨领域创作。
en: Let lettering in the work supply visual variety.
Arrange covers in a consistent rhythm.
Use a short introduction to connect work across disciplines.

bestFor.zh: 字体与插画作品集、书籍展示
bestFor.en: Lettering portfolios, illustration, and book showcases

description.zh: 大片留白与简短自我介绍，将注意力集中到作者和几个必要入口。
description.en: Generous whitespace and a short introduction focus attention on the author and a few essential controls.

zh: 首屏只说姓名与正在做的事情。
语言与主题切换收纳在紧凑工具条中。
用留白而不是装饰强调主体。
en: Limit the opening to a name and a concrete activity.
Group language and theme controls into a compact toolbar.
Use space rather than decoration to emphasize the subject.

bestFor.zh: 双语个人主页、极简首屏
bestFor.en: Bilingual personal sites and minimal heroes

description.zh: 轻快线条人像与清楚的自我介绍，展示创意开发者的个人风格。
description.en: A light illustrated portrait and clear introduction express a creative developer’s personality.

zh: 用定制人像代替通用装饰图。
插画配色与标题颜色保持呼应。
把联系入口留在容易发现的位置。
en: Choose a custom portrait over a generic decorative illustration.
Echo illustration colors in the typography.
Keep a contact action easy to find.

bestFor.zh: 插画个人主页、创意开发者作品集
bestFor.en: Illustrated homepages and creative developer portfolios

description.zh: 直接的问候、清晰的职业介绍与人物照片，建立可信的专业主页。
description.en: A direct greeting, clear professional introduction, and portrait establish a credible personal site.

zh: 用具体工作内容说明身份，少堆抽象标签。
让博客、演讲和课程拥有清楚入口。
保留跳转正文等阅读与键盘使用细节。
en: Describe actual work instead of stacking abstract labels.
Make writing, speaking, and courses easy to locate.
Retain reading and keyboard details such as skip navigation.

bestFor.zh: 专业个人介绍、可访问性参考
bestFor.en: Professional biographies and accessibility references

description.zh: 大字自我定位与紧凑头像，呈现一个正在迭代的个人网站。
description.en: A bold identity statement and compact portrait introduce a personal site that openly evolves.

zh: 把重要词语用单一强调色突出。
短段落比履历长列表更适合介绍个人方向。
将改版记录链接出来，让维护过程也能被阅读。
en: Highlight important words with one accent color.
Use short paragraphs to explain direction rather than a long résumé list.
Link redesign notes so the evolution is visible.

bestFor.zh: 个人介绍、公开迭代记录
bestFor.en: Personal introductions and public redesign notes

description.zh: 手绘猫咪、纸片色块与图文入口，把博客做成一本私人剪贴簿。
description.en: A hand-drawn cat, paper-like panels, and illustrated links make the blog feel like a personal scrapbook.

zh: 导航入口也可以拥有各自的小插画。
不规则色块统一使用柔和色调，避免视觉争抢。
方格纸背景将不同模块连接成一个画面。
en: Give navigation entries their own small illustrations.
Keep irregular panels in a soft palette so they cooperate.
Use graph-paper texture to connect separate modules.

bestFor.zh: 手账式博客、生活记录
bestFor.en: Scrapbook-style blogs and personal journals

description.zh: 紫色影像与醒目的标题，让开发者内容站拥有节目片头般的气氛。
description.en: Purple imagery and assertive lettering give a developer-content site the energy of a show opening.

zh: 背景影像围绕作者的内容主题选择。
高对比标题确保在复杂背景上仍能读清。
将导航紧靠定位语，让访客立即知道下一步。
en: Choose background imagery that relates to the author’s content.
Keep headlines readable over a busy visual.
Place navigation beside the positioning statement.

bestFor.zh: 视频作者主页、节目型个人站
bestFor.en: Video-creator homepages and show-oriented sites

description.zh: 文件夹侧栏与图片墙，把写作和生活片段装进个人档案界面。
description.en: A folder sidebar and photo wall frame writing and everyday moments as a personal archive.

zh: 用文件系统隐喻解释多种内容类型。
缩略图墙为文字之外的生活记录提供入口。
侧栏折叠控制让不同屏幕也能集中浏览。
en: Use a filesystem metaphor to organize different content types.
Offer a thumbnail wall for visual everyday notes.
Let sidebar controls give the content more room.

bestFor.zh: 个人档案、图文混合博客
bestFor.en: Personal archives and mixed photo-and-text blogs

description.zh: 场景图与清楚的服务标题，连接设计、工程和教学内容。
description.en: A scene image and clear service heading connect design, engineering, and teaching.

zh: 首屏明确写出提供的能力，而不依赖访客推断。
将场景图用于建立工作气氛。
首页、文章、课程和联系入口保持直接。
en: State capabilities in the hero rather than asking visitors to infer them.
Use a scene image to establish a working atmosphere.
Keep home, writing, courses, and contact directly accessible.

bestFor.zh: 设计工程师介绍、教学内容入口
bestFor.en: Design-engineer introductions and educational hubs

description.zh: 橙色刊头与窄栏文章目录，保留鲜明的独立博客气质。
description.en: An orange masthead and narrow article index preserve a distinctive independent-blog character.

zh: 将品牌色集中在刊头与边缘装饰。
近期文章列表优先，让回访读者快速找到更新。
主题分类把大量技术文章变得可以浏览。
en: Concentrate the brand color in the masthead and edge accents.
Prioritize recent posts for returning readers.
Use topic categories to make a large technical archive browsable.

bestFor.zh: 技术文章索引、复古博客
bestFor.en: Technical article indexes and retro blogs

description.zh: 直接从一篇文章开始，没有复杂首页，阅读本身就是入口。
description.en: The site opens directly into an essay: reading itself becomes the entrance.

zh: 让最新内容直接出现，减少进入正文的步骤。
窄栏与宽留白让长段落更容易阅读。
文章结束处再交代作者，保持开头的专注。
en: Show the latest writing directly to remove a step before reading.
Use a narrow measure and wide margins for longer paragraphs.
Introduce the author after the essay to keep the opening focused.

bestFor.zh: 纯写作博客、单篇阅读页面
bestFor.en: Writing-first blogs and focused essay pages
